Oskarsson Strikes First Amid VAR Review The opening stages were a physical affair, with Sergio Gomez and Yangel Herrera picking up early bookings. The deadlock was finally broken in the 29th minute when Orri Oskarsson found the back of the net with a clinical right-footed finish. The goal was the result of a fluid move involving a key pass from Job Ochieng and a direct assist from Sergio Gomez . After a tense wait for a VAR check, the referee confirmed the goal, giving Real Sociedad a deserved lead that they carried into the halftime break despite pressure from Ramon Terrats and the Espanyol midfield. Espanyol Fight Back Through VAR Drama The second half was a showcase of resilience from the visiting side. Espanyol initially thought they had equalized in the 54th minute, but a lengthy VAR intervention resulted in the goal being revoked for a foul in the build-up. Undeterred, the visitors continued to push, and their persistence paid off in the 65th minute. Substitute Pere Milla provided a perfectly timed assist for Roberto Fernandez , who slotted home the equalizer. This time, the goal stood after a video review, setting up a grandstand finish. A Dramatic Conclusion and Stalemate The final ten minutes were filled with incident and tactical substitutions, as both managers introduced fresh legs like Mikel Oyarzabal and Lluc Castell . In the 80th minute, the VAR was called into action once more for a potential Espanyol penalty, though play ultimately resumed with a goal kick for the hosts. Deep into stoppage time, Tyrhys Dolan nearly snatched all three points for the visitors, but Real Sociedad goalkeeper Unai Marrero produced a vital save to ensure the match ended in a -1 draw, leaving both sides with a hard-earned point.
